# Repository conventions

Use the [development guide](../docs/development.md) for setup, paths and tests, and the [architecture guide](../docs/architecture.md) for code placement. Keep AEMO and household results separate. The [preprint reproduction guide](../docs/reproduction.md) identifies current AEMO evidence and separates it from historical experiments.

For constrained training experiments only, follow the [experiment protocol](../docs/experiment_protocol.md). General maintenance is not restricted to the training entry point.
